I’m a Power Platform and Microsoft 365 engineer focused on building practical solutions that improve processes, reduce manual administration and make technology easier for people to use.
My work combines low-code development with Microsoft 365, cloud services, APIs, automation and governance.
This portfolio documents selected projects and technical lessons from that work.

Engineering practical solutions with Microsoft technology#I specialise in building secure, governed solutions using Microsoft Power Platform and Microsoft 365, with a focus on automation, operational improvement and making complex processes easier for people to use.
My work spans Power Apps, Power Automate, SharePoint, Microsoft Graph, Dataverse, Azure Automation and Copilot, bringing these technologies together to solve real business problems.
This site is a collection of selected projects, technical approaches and things I’ve learned along the way.
